findings.title: Preserve focus after rebuilding layer controls
findings.change: Restore the focused layer/control identity after selection and successful or rejected visibility staging, without moving focus away from another control or a replaced source history.
findings.regressionBefore: Pinned inspector browser acceptance fails: Selecting a layer must preserve keyboard focus; actual false.
verification: Full inspector desktop/phone/watch/save/MP4 acceptance passes with repeated layer and Hide/Show/Solo keyboard activation, rejected asset-load rollback, and no focus stealing during a paused asset load.

findings.title: Preserve assets belonging to retained dirty drafts
findings.change: Retain immutable registered asset snapshots for accepted program drafts using bounded connection-owned leases. Edits, undo/redo, renderer switches and MP4 export use the accepted draft lease. Failed candidate loads, replaced sources/saves and closed connections release their leases. Recent revisions remain independently bounded to two.
findings.regressionBefore: After repeated valid source/asset rebuilds, the dirty draft loses its assets: the next edit reports Asset unavailable: art Previous valid preview is preserved. Its original revision has been evicted.
verification: Three external source and registered-asset changes preserve the accepted draft revision, frame, edits, undo/redo and Canvas/WebGL switching.
Retained draft MP4 is byte-identical to an independent CLI render of the edited document using the original red SVG bytes.
Stale saves still reject with comp-edit-conflict. Failed reload releases the proposed lease; accepted reload retires the draft lease. Closing another page releases only that connection's leases.
Four unit regressions cover recent-revision eviction, exact revision/token lookup, owner-only release, disconnected-owner cleanup, the 64-lease bound, capacity recovery and server shutdown.

limitations: Full pnpm check, unrelated browser groups, Python depth suites and frozen baselines are not rerun for this focused repair slice. No baselines are regenerated.
